entries.title: I Chronicles 27:1
segments: ¶And the children of Israel, according to their number, the heads of fathers' [houses], the captains of thousands and hundreds and their officers, served the king in every matter of the [military] divisions. [These divisions] came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, each division [having] twenty-four thousand.

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:2
segments: Over the first division for the first month [was] Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel, and in his division [were] twenty-four thousand;

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:3
segments: [he was] of the children of Perez, and the chief of all the captains of the army for the first month.

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:4
segments: Over the division of the second month [was] Dodai an Ahohite, and of his division Mikloth also [was] the leader; in his division [were] twenty-four thousand.

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:5
segments: The third captain of the army for the third month [was] Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the priest, who was chief; in his division [were] twenty-four thousand.

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:6
segments: This was the Benaiah [who was] mighty [among] the thirty, and was over the thirty; in his division [was] Ammizabad his son.

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:7
segments: The fourth [captain] for the fourth month [was] Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him; in his division [were] twenty-four thousand.

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:8
segments: The fifth [captain] for the fifth month [was] Shamhuth the Izrahite; in his division were twenty-four thousand.

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:9
segments: The sixth [captain] for the sixth month [was] Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite; in his division [were] twenty-four thousand.

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:10
segments: The seventh [captain] for the seventh month [was] Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim; in his division [were] twenty-four thousand.

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:11
segments: The eighth [captain] for the eighth month [was] Sibbechai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites; in his division [were] twenty-four thousand.

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:12
segments: The ninth [captain] for the ninth month [was] Abiezer the Anathothite, of the Benjamites; in his division [were] twenty-four thousand.

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:13
segments: The tenth [captain] for the tenth month [was] Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites; in his division [were] twenty-four thousand.

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:14
segments: The eleventh [captain] for the eleventh month [was] Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim; in his division [were] twenty-four thousand.

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:15
segments: The twelfth [captain] for the twelfth month [was] Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel; in his division [were] twenty-four thousand.

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:16
segments: ¶Furthermore, over the tribes of Israel: the officer over the Reubenites [was] Eliezer the son of Zichri; over the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah;

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:17
segments: [over] the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel; over the Aaronites, Zadok;

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:18
segments: [over] Judah, Elihu, [one] of David's brothers; [over] Issachar, Omri the son of Michael;

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:19
segments: [over] Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah; [over] Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel;

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:20
segments: [over] the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah; [over] the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah;

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:21
segments: [over] the half-[tribe] of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah; [over] Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner;

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:22
segments: [over] Dan, Azarel the son of Jeroham. These [were] the leaders of the tribes of Israel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:23
segments: But David did not take the number of those twenty years old and under, because the LORD had said He would multiply Israel like the stars of the heavens.

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:24
segments: Joab the son of Zeruiah began a census, but he did not finish, for wrath came upon Israel because of this census; nor was the number recorded in the account of the chronicles of King David.

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:25
segments: And Azmaveth the son of Adiel [was] over the king's treasuries; and Jehonathan the son of Uzziah was over the storehouses in the field, in the cities, in the villages, and in the fortresses.

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:26
segments: Ezri the son of Chelub was over those who did the work of the field for tilling the ground.

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:27
segments: And Shimei the Ramathite [was] over the vineyards, and Zabdi the Shiphmite was over the produce of the vineyards for the supply of wine.

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:28
segments: Baal-Hanan the Gederite was over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that [were] in the lowlands, and Joash [was] over the store of oil.

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:29
segments: And Shitrai the Sharonite [was] over the herds that fed in Sharon, and Shaphat the son of Adlai was over the herds [that were] in the valleys.

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:30
segments: Obil the Ishmaelite [was] over the camels, Jehdeiah the Meronothite [was] over the donkeys,

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:31
segments: and Jaziz the Hagrite [was] over the flocks. All these [were] the officials over King David's property.

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:32
segments: Also Jehonathan, David's uncle, [was] a counselor, a wise man, and a scribe; and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni [was] with the king's sons.

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:33
segments: Ahithophel [was] the king's counselor, and Hushai the Archite [was] the king's companion.

entries.title: I Chronicles 27:34
segments: After Ahithophel [was] Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, then Abiathar. And the general of the king's army [was] Joab.
